source: This position makes L2 useful for reuse that crosses block or ZXNAME0000XZ boundaries. A tile evicted from one ZXNAME0001XZ’s L1 may still be available in L2 when another block needs the same region. Repeated model-weight reads, shared lookup tables, and overlapping tensor tiles can therefore benefit even when software does not explicitly coordinate the reuse.
zh: 此位置使得 L2 对于跨块或 ZXNAME0000XZ 边界的重用非常有用。当另一个块需要相同区域时，从 ZXNAME0001XZ 的 L1 驱逐的图块可能仍然在 L2 中可用。因此，即使软件没有明确协调重用，重复的模型权重读取、共享查找表和重叠张量图块也可以受益。
